fields.why: Table 1 gives asthma prevalence per level for age (3), race/ethnicity (4), household income (5) and education (3), with Rao-Scott chi-square marks on all but education.
Age, race/ethnicity and SES (income, education) each have 3+ groups compared; sex is two groups and state is not an SPD.

Education rows lack the ** Rao-Scott mark and the text omits education from the significant differences, so side by side is defensible; since the methods say Rao-Scott was the test for differences, education may have been tested and found nonsignificant (omnibus test). The mechanical flag is a record-level match, not evidence that the education entry was tested.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a characteristic without a significance mark, in a table whose note marks only p<0.05 rows, was tested (omnibus) or only shown (side by side).
